title: A nerve cell firing

data.source: Integrate-and-fire neuron with white noise and an adaptation current, simulated here from the standard equations

prediction: Fixed in advance as restates: the standard model's known results come out in CRR's words (first-passage CV within 5% of the law; neighbouring gaps negatively correlated with adaptation; path length grows as the time step shrinks).
baseline: The integrate-and-fire model and its closed-form first-passage law.
why: A cut at the first passage of a count is the definition of an integrate-and-fire neuron, a model from 1907. The numbers agree with the textbook, as they must. One real caution came out: with raw white noise the count has no fixed size, so the noise has to be smoothed before CRR's count means anything.
